items.lede: The U.S. and China have proposed implementing AI red lines that will not be crossed, as well as a hotline between the two countries to provide rapid communication and opportunities for joint responses to rogue AI actions.
items.title: US and China propose hotline to de-escalate AI threats ahead of Washington summit

items.lede: As the US and China race to become the dominant power in the AI industry, the countries also appear to be figuring out ways to communicate on national security issues.
items.title: A US-China AI Hotline Won't Be Ready For a While
